chunks: "Do not enter your homes in Mecca when you have visited, meaning the residents of Mecca."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instruct the residents of Mecca regarding entering their homes during the Mina visitation?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام gives an instruction related to the conduct of the people of Mecca in the context of visitation. The report concerns legal etiquette connected to staying in Mina and not returning to one's houses in Mecca during that observance.
